en.name: [Deprecated] Decision authority documented
en.shortDescription: Deprecated — replaced by the Surrogate decision maker documented concept set (290); use that set instead.
en.longDescription:
**Deprecated.** Use the **Surrogate decision maker documented** concept set (290) instead; kept for history.

The only member, `1032192` — Decision authority documented (`LP74704-5`), is a non-standard LOINC Part, and the LOINC answer `45877806` — *The patient has designated a decision-maker …* (`LA11786-3`) discussed in issue #21 is a Meas Value concept that belongs in `value_as_concept_id`, not in a concept set. The same variable is covered by the standard SNOMED observation `762209` — Active healthcare surrogate (`3021000175108`) in set 290; a site recording the CARE item maps it to `762209` as `observation_concept_id` and may keep `45877806` as `value_as_concept_id`.

reviews.comments:
## Summary
**Needs revision.** Please replace the non-standard LOINC Part LP74704-5 (1032192) with the standard answer concept 45877806 / LA11786-3 as agreed in [issue #21](https://github.com/indicate-eu/data-dictionary/issues/21), and move the set from draft to pending review. Our CQL (QI08) uses 45877806, so the current concept is not referenced.

## Use in our quality indicators
- Used in QI08 (Advance care plan).
- CQL: no concept of this set is referenced by our libraries.

## Suggestions
- Replace LP74704-5 (1032192) by 45877806 / LA11786-3 and move the set to pending review.
